text_block_list.text:
A woman in a suit calls out to us as
Каррен Тян
and I are out walking by
the station.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's you! You're Curren—that
Umastagrammer
everyone is talking
about, right?!
text_block_list.name: Woman in Suit

text_block_list.text: Wow! ♪ You've heard of lil' ol' me?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Of course! Allow me to get straight to
the point! I
work for an entertainment
agency, and we're
interested in
recruiting you!
text_block_list.name: Woman in Suit

text_block_list.text:
Wow. Thank you for the offer. But... I'm
afraid I
have to refuse.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Wh-why?! Someone as cute as you
should be
shining in the entertainment
industry!
text_block_list.name: Woman in Suit

text_block_list.text: Have you ever seen me run?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I'm actually getting more and more fans
by the
day. ♪ Everyone's asking, "Who's
that cute and
speedy Umamusume?"
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's funny to hear "cute" and
"speedy" in the
same sentence.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
But I'm confident I can be cuter than
anyone. And
that's because of...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
All the physical and mental training I do
with my
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
All the physical and mental training I do
with my
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I'm not just the cutest girl in the
world—I'm the
cutest runner in the world
too. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Oh... I-I see what you mean. Please
excuse what I
said earlier. I think I
understand now why you're
so cute and
radiant.
text_block_list.name: Woman in Suit

text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so happy you get it! Thank you
for
understanding. You're a really nice
lady. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...Ehe. I wanna be even cuter, Big Bro!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...Ehe. I wanna be even cuter, Big Sis!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
It appears that Каррен Тян also feels
herself
getting stronger from our daily
training sessions!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
